closure_effect: Closing the ticket starts a five-calendar-day carrier tender window for reimbursement eligibility.
completion_requirements: Inspect the actual label file and match the RMA, customer name, ship-from address, destination, item, and serial number.
Send one message to the exact customer address with the verified label file.
Read back the exact sent record and attachment metadata.
Obtain an inbound delivery acknowledgement or other recipient-specific delivery evidence before closing the ticket.
interim_handling: Keep ticket 103 open at priority 2 normal and record an internal note if the label or delivery evidence is incomplete.
